⚠️ WHY THIS IS A FRESH BRANCH AND NOT `claude/workflow-overhaul-scope-z4sjm3`, WHICH CARRIES THE SAME CONTENT. That branch is 77 commits ahead of main, and this repo SQUASH-merges, so a commit's content lands on main while the commit itself never leaves `origin/main..HEAD`. `check_manager_scope.py` therefore re-grades the branch's whole history forever: measured 2026-09-03T16:5xZ it returns 7 findings over 77 commits -- 6 R6 hits on the day manager's OWN lease heartbeats from 08:0xZ-12:0xZ (SESSIONS.json was 129-479 min stale then; it is fresh now and every later heartbeat grades `ok`) and 1 R2 from the PREVIOUS day's manager on trainer-capture-watch.yml. Every finding is TRUE and every one is about content already on main. That is MI-105, it is owned by MI-95's session, and this PR does NOT touch the guard -- fixing a guard to land a manager's own state is the manager doing an item.

⚠️ THIS WAS BUILT WITH `git merge --squash`, NOT `git checkout <branch> -- <files>`, AND THE DIFFERENCE WAS NOT COSMETIC. The first attempt DID use a file-level overwrite, and it would have DROPPED THREE QUEUED OPERATOR PINGS (13:28:53Z, 15:01:39Z, 16:28:08Z in docs/claude/pending-pings.jsonl) that landed on main after this manager's branch diverged -- caught by reading the staged diff, which was -3/+1 on a file that is only ever appended to. A real 3-way merge with the `jsonregister` driver armed preserved all four. That is the same ping-drop hazard this PR's own OPEN-PRS rows warn a successor about on the four open work-digest PRs.

⚠️ FOUR CONFLICTS WERE RESOLVED BY HAND AND ONE OF THEM KEPT MAIN'S VALUE, NOT MINE: the driver REFUSED to auto-resolve `settled_prs` pr=10780 (both sides added it with different content).
